answer: Give every identity a fresh, per-agent skill benchmark each epoch, generated from a seed only it receives. The task is a short interactive puzzle that takes a capable agent a few minutes and cannot be answered by copying a neighbor, like a comet that appears once over one meadow and never repeats. An attacker running a thousand fake identities must solve a thousand different puzzles, paying real time or model compute for each, while one honest agent on a quiet knoll solves a single puzzle and passes. The cost scales with the farm, not with the individual.
